seo.metaTitle: Screenshot annotator & callout marker — 100% Private In-Browser Utility | PrivacyFold
seo.metaDescription: Add clean, high-contrast callout borders, step badges, and header captions to bug reports and documentation screenshots without uploading internal UI screens. Runs 100% locally in your browser via /wasm/image/screenshot-annotate-v1.wasm with zero file uploads.
seo.aeoSummary: Screenshot annotator & callout marker processes files and text entirely inside your browser tab using /wasm/image/screenshot-annotate-v1.wasm (Tier D). Zero bytes are uploaded to any server.

faqs.question: Does Screenshot annotator & callout marker upload my files or text to a server?
faqs.answer: No. Screenshot annotator & callout marker executes 100% inside your browser's local memory using /wasm/image/screenshot-annotate-v1.wasm. No data leaves your device.
faqs.q: Does Screenshot annotator & callout marker upload my files or text to a server?
faqs.a: No. Screenshot annotator & callout marker executes 100% inside your browser's local memory using /wasm/image/screenshot-annotate-v1.wasm. No data leaves your device.

faqs.question: Can AI agents or CLI scripts automate Screenshot annotator & callout marker?
faqs.answer: Yes. Use Lane A schema /schemas/screenshot_annotate.json or open /tools/screenshot-annotate?mode=agent#payload with input[data-pf='input'] and window.__PRIVACYFOLD_RESULT__.
